name: Hazarmaveth
title: Descendant of Shem
summary: Hazarmaveth was a son of Joktan and a grandson of Eber, who was a descendant of Shem, Noah's son. He is regarded as the ancestor of a people and a region in southern Arabia, known today as Hadramaut in Yemen. He is mentioned in the genealogies in Genesis and 1 Chronicles as part of the table of nations after the flood.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Table of Nations
keyEvents.description: Hazarmaveth is mentioned as one of Joktan's sons in the table of nations that describes how the nations spread after the flood.

keyEvents.title: The Sons of Joktan Listed
keyEvents.description: Hazarmaveth is listed among Joktan's thirteen sons who settled in the regions from Mesha to Sephar in the eastern mountainous land.

keyEvents.title: Repeated in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: The genealogy from Genesis is repeated in 1 Chronicles, where Hazarmaveth is again mentioned as a son of Joktan in Shem's lineage.

keyEvents.title: Shem's Lineage
keyEvents.description: Hasarmavet is placed in the blessed lineage from Shem through Eber and Joktan, representing an important branch of the Semitic peoples.

keyEvents.title: The Dispersion of the Nations
keyEvents.description: After the Tower of Babel, the descendants of Joktan, including the people of Hasarmavet, spread to southern Arabia and established their territories there.
